author: Akien
prose:
[2026-09-15] tester is generating emails i think the tester should be self clearing thsoe, yes?

[2026-09-15, on CC's measurement that default receive() records mail nobody reads] well thing is press_office should have a data recorder that should suck that up already. but i'd bet you never built anything to activate it from the email. we're going to give ownership of that to the cairn device. it can own cairn folders not owned by another device.

[2026-09-16, correcting CC's reading 'cairn owns the unowned residue'] no we're going to give press_office to cairn device.

[2026-09-16, on the tester's own mail] the tester gets all the tester emails and it can decide to throw them away or whatever it would like to do. i assume it will throw most of them away. i wouldn't be surprised if sooner or later it has to watch for a specific email as part of a test, but that's a long time from now.

[2026-09-16, on the standing 677 undelivered] they can be thrown away but in future that's tester's job not ours. so it has to be able to do that
